newsitem.title: THAILAND: Chevron to invest in Thai petrochem plant.
newsitem.headline: Chevron to invest in Thai petrochem plant.

text.p: A Thai industry ministry official said on Monday that Chevron Chemical Co of the United States, a unit of Chevron Corp, was to invest 30 billion baht in a petrochemical project in Thailand.
The plant is expected to produce 675,000 tonnes of paraxylene and 600,000 tonnes of benzene a year.
The plant is scheduled to be ready for startup by 2000. The company was now conducting an engineering study on the project, the ministry official said.
Paraxylene and benzene are products used to make plastics and textiles.
The US energy giant will hold 60 percent stake in the project while state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand will hold the remaining 40 percent, the official said.

He added that Chevron Chemical chose Thailand for the major project because of the growing demand for the products, attractive investment incentives, easy access to raw materials and good infrastructure.
About 80 percent of the production would be exported within the region and the rest sold to the local market, he said.
